items.difficulty_reason: Adjunction lemma (statement 1760-1772, proof 1774-1789): the module-level Tensor-Hom adjunction - the proof exhibits the same set of differential-compatible A-bilinear maps on both sides, the right side by the defining universal property of the tensor product and the left side via the standard total-complex composition lemma; the A-linearity transfer is carried out explicitly; no step is omitted. H2: standard adjunction identification.
